segments.t: Now that she knows Denis never cheated on her, Katya calls her father Viktor Petrovich for advice. Having just reached the final round of the cooking show, Barinov listens to his daughter's confession while dealing with his own chaos. Let's listen to their phone call in Russian.
Алло, папа, тебе сейчас удобно говорить?
Ладно, папа, я была не права.
Я признаю, он мне не изменял.
Между ним и Викой ничего нет.
Я же тебе сразу это говорил.
Денис у нас правда хороший парень.
Только давай без вашей мужской солидарности.
Ладно, дочка, как ты сама думаешь?
Как думаешь, мне стоит его простить?
Знаешь, я тебе сейчас плохой советчик.
У меня самого в жизни беспорядок.
Ладно, не буду тебя отвлекать, пока.
Now let's break down the phone call between Katya and her father line by line.
Алло, папа, тебе сейчас удобно говорить?
'Hello, Dad, is it convenient for you to talk right now?' Katya checks on her father's timing using a dative pronoun and predicate adverb.
Ладно, папа, я была не права.
'All right, Dad, I was wrong.' A negated short feminine predicate adjective with the past of to be admits a mistake.
Я признаю, он мне не изменял.
'I admit it, he did not cheat on me.' The verb meaning to betray or cheat on governs the dative case of the person wronged.
Между ним и Викой ничего нет.
'There is nothing between him and Vika.' Both pronouns and nouns after the preposition meaning between stand in the instrumental case.
Я же тебе сразу это говорил.
'I told you that right from the start.' Barinov reminds his daughter that he defended his young cook earlier.
Денис у нас правда хороший парень.
'Denis really is a good guy.' He praises Denis using a masculine nominative singular adjective and noun.
Только давай без вашей мужской солидарности.
'Just spare me your male solidarity.' The preposition meaning without governs the genitive singular of the feminine phrase male solidarity.
Ладно, дочка, как ты сама думаешь?
'All right, sweetheart, what do you think yourself?' Barinov softens his tone and addresses Katya affectionately as little daughter.
Как думаешь, мне стоит его простить?
'What do you think, should I forgive him?' The impersonal verb of worth with a dative pronoun and infinitive asks if something is worth doing.
Знаешь, я тебе сейчас плохой советчик.
'You know, I am a poor adviser for you right now.' A masculine predicate noun expresses that he is in no position to give relationship advice.
У меня самого в жизни беспорядок.
'My own life is a complete mess.' An emphatic genitive pronoun highlights that Barinov's own affairs are in chaos.
Ладно, не буду тебя отвлекать, пока.

'All right, I will not distract you, bye.' Katya says goodbye using a negated compound future verb and informal farewell. Let's hear the phone conversation between Katya and Barinov from start to finish.

Although Viktor Petrovich vouches that Denis is a good guy, both father and daughter admit that their lives are in complete turmoil right now. Listen for the short feminine adjective meaning right and the infinitive meaning to forgive. See you in the next scene.
